title: Sharing Pollinations looks more like Pollinations
summary:
A small polish day: cleaner social sharing and refreshed usage signals across the site.

Social share assets were updated and repaired, so links have a more reliable, current presentation when they leave the garden.

GA4 events were refreshed across the product, giving maintainers cleaner signals about what people actually do after arriving. Analytics: the part where software admits it has been guessing.
